digest.component_or_area: root modules and services (src/rebar, attest, metrics, review_bot, opcert_service, audit, grounding, _guides)
propositions: Comment corpus in scope (root modules and services) contains verified-stale inline rationale and documentation that should be relocated to ADRs or consolidated rather than force-deleted.

Schema assurance comment in _mcp_models.py was stale but is now accurate on main (BridgeFsckOut declares binding_drift and CI drift gate exists); this comment must remain KEEP/DO_NOT_MOVE and must not be re-corrected.
Machine-consumed markers (_config_schema.py read-via comments, _mcp_llm.py FastMCP tool docstrings) are API surface or CI gates and must not be deleted or relocated.

_config_schema.py contains ~280 comment lines that are the sole documentation for many config keys (e.g., completion_floor_active, comment_max_chars) and cannot be recovered without first writing docs/config.md rows.

review_bot/ contains three multi-line inline rationale blocks (bounded shutdown, in-flight counter over-count, retryable coverage-gap deferral) that should be relocated to new ADRs (0067, 0068, 0069) and replaced with one-line citations.
The disposition log must be appended to .joe-janitor/tools.md before any edits land, and the recovered comment-line count must be measured by diff and recorded as output rather than used as a target.
